items.question: What is PFE Guidance?
items.answer: PFE Guidance is an intelligent workspace that helps students structure, build and defend their Final Year Project deliverables.

items.question: Is PFE Guidance free?
items.answer: Yes. The Free plan gives students access to core modules, basic AI help, a project workspace and progress tracking.

items.question: What is included in Premium?
items.answer: Premium adds more AI generations, advanced report support, presentation assistance, jury simulation, templates and priority access to new AI features.

items.question: Can I use it for any engineering PFE?
items.answer: Yes. The workflow is designed for engineering and computer science PFE projects, while remaining flexible for different technical domains.

items.question: Does the AI write my entire report?
items.answer: No. AI assists with structure, consistency, suggestions and drafting support, while the student stays responsible for validating and editing the work.

items.question: How does Jury Simulation work?
items.answer: It uses your project context to generate realistic defense questions so you can practice answers before the final presentation.

items.question: Can I export my work?
items.answer: Export behavior depends on the active workspace modules and will evolve as report, presentation and template features mature.

items.question: Is my project data private?
items.answer: Project data is treated as private workspace content. Teams should still avoid adding secrets or confidential third-party data unless their own policy allows it.
